He never wanted more, and he was happier than most people with more.

Kevin Trudeau describes his dad, a union welder. A new car every three years, an above-ground pool and a little house he built himself. Monday was bowling, Tuesday the gun club, Sunday roast beef with the family.

Kevin says life never got bigger, but his father was incredibly happy. At the end he said he loved his life, lived it as he wanted, and had no regrets.

What would no regrets look like in your life?
